Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jaren Jackson Jr.?

Jaren Jackson Jr. is 26 years old.

Where was Jaren Jackson Jr. born?

Jaren Jackson Jr. was born in Plainfield, New Jersey.

When was Jaren Jackson Jr. born?

Jaren Jackson Jr. was born on September 15, 1999.

How tall is Jaren Jackson Jr.?

Jaren Jackson Jr. is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much does Jaren Jackson Jr. weigh?

Jaren Jackson Jr. weighs 242 lbs (109 kg).

Is Jaren Jackson Jr. in the Hall of Fame?

Jaren Jackson Jr. is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jaren Jackson Jr. drafted?

Jaren Jackson Jr. was drafted by Memphis Grizzlies, 1st round (4th pick, 4th overall), 2018 NBA Draft.

What position does Jaren Jackson Jr. play?

Center and Power Forward.

What is Jaren Jackson Jr.'s net worth?

Jaren Jackson Jr. has made at least $145,587,045 playing professional basketball.

How much does Jaren Jackson Jr. make?

Jaren Jackson Jr. made $35,000,000 in 2026.

How many rings does Jaren Jackson Jr. have?

Jaren Jackson Jr. has won 0 championships.

What is Jaren Jackson Jr.'s Instagram account?

Jaren Jackson Jr. is on Instagram at jaren.

What schools did Jaren Jackson Jr. attend?

Jaren Jackson Jr. attended La Lumiere School in La Porte, Indiana and Michigan State.

What are Jaren Jackson Jr.'s nicknames?

JJJ, Block Panther are nicknames for Jaren Jackson Jr..

Is Jaren Jackson Jr. injured?

Jaren Jackson Jr. is listed as Out For Season (Knee) - The Jazz said on Thursday (Feb. 12) that Jackson Jr. will miss the rest of the season to undergo knee surgery.
